Qmines (ASX:QML) has informed investors that new copper‑gold drilling results have been reported from beneath the old pit at its Mt Chalmers project in Queensland. The update was issued via the company’s announcement on Kalkine, a news aggregator platform featured by Google News. This disclosure reflects ongoing exploration progress at the Mt Chalmers site.
